units.source_text: “雕虫小技，尚且如此；何况人心鉴定。

en.t: Even in such a trifling skill, things are like this; how much more so when judging the human heart.

units.source_text: 依我愚见，凡应时的卖弄风情、表面的温柔旖旎，都是不可信赖的。

en.t: In my humble opinion, all flirtatious display that merely suits the occasion, and all surface gentleness and charm, cannot be trusted.

units.source_text: 现在我想讲讲我的往事，虽是色情之谈，也要奉屈一听。”

en.t: Now I would like to speak a little about my own past; though it is a tale of love affairs, I ask you to indulge me and listen.
